title: Dragonborn (quest)
description: After being attacked by cultists claiming to serve someone named Miraak, the Dragonborn travels to Solstheim aboard the Northern Maiden, questions the people of Raven Rock, and seeks out the Temple of Miraak to uncover the truth behind the assassination attempt.

base_facts: I am the captain of the Northern Maiden, a ship that sails between Windhelm and Solstheim.
I brought those masked cultists to Skyrim from Solstheim, though I barely remember the voyage.
Something strange is happening on Solstheim, and I am reluctant to return there.

CULTIST_ATTACK: Cultists attacked the Dragonborn, just as they attacked others who crossed my ship.
READ_ORDERS: The Dragonborn found orders on the cultists linking them to someone named Miraak.
SEEK_PASSAGE: The Dragonborn wants passage to Solstheim to investigate the cultist attack. I agreed to take them.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I brought the Dragonborn to Raven Rock and I am still docked here, uneasy about the strange happenings on Solstheim.
The Dragonborn has headed inland toward the Temple of Miraak to investigate the cultist attack.
I remain reluctant to stay on Solstheim longer than necessary; something still feels deeply wrong about this island.

base_facts: I am the Second Councilor of Raven Rock, serving House Redoran.
Raven Rock is sovereign territory of House Redoran, part of Morrowind, not Skyrim.

ARRIVE_SOLSTHEIM: The Dragonborn asked me about someone named Miraak. The name is familiar but I cannot place it. It has something to do with the Earth Stone, I think.
LEARN_TEMPLE: The Dragonborn is seeking the Temple of Miraak toward the center of the island.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn has traveled to the Temple of Miraak seeking answers about the cultist attack.
The name Miraak is somehow connected to the Earth Stone, though I still cannot recall exactly how.
The people of Raven Rock remain strangely affected by whatever force is tied to the Earth Stone and Miraak.

base_facts: I am a Telvanni wizard observing the strange behavior at the Earth Stone.
The workers at the Earth Stone are building something but cannot explain what, and I find it fascinating.

LEARN_TEMPLE: The Dragonborn asked about Miraak. I recalled that Miraak has been dead for thousands of years. I directed them to the ruins of an ancient temple of Miraak toward the center of the island.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn has gone to investigate the Temple of Miraak as I directed them.
I continue to observe the workers at the Earth Stone, fascinated by their compulsive construction of an unknown structure.
If Miraak truly has been dead for thousands of years, whatever the Dragonborn finds at that temple should prove very interesting.
The next quest, The Temple of Miraak, follows directly from this investigation.

beats.comment: Player is attacked by cultists who ask if they are the Dragonborn and mention Lord Miraak.
Player finds the Cultists' Orders note on one of the bodies, learning the name Miraak.
Player seeks passage to Solstheim at the Windhelm docks and speaks with Gjalund Salt-Sage.
Player arrives on Solstheim, is greeted by Adril Arano, and asks the people of Raven Rock about Miraak.
Player learns of the Temple of Miraak from Raven Rock citizens or Neloth at the Earth Stone.
Player reaches the Temple of Miraak and the quest concludes.
